summary: Spire Missouri Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Spire Inc., closed a $350 million offering of 6.200% First Mortgage Bonds due 2036 under an October 5, 2026 underwriting agreement led by BofA Securities, TD Securities, Regions Securities, and U.S. Bancorp Investments. The bonds were issued off an effective Form S-3 shelf and are secured by a Mortgage and Deed of Trust with Regions Bank as successor trustee, evidenced by the Forty-Second Supplemental Indenture dated October 8, 2026. Net proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, potentially repaying short-term debt. This is a routine debt takedown, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing cadence.
